title: Entity identity does not substitute for a full-state observation
question: Compare ID-only equality with the state fields required to establish failure atomicity.

evidence.title: Entity identity equality is distinct from full-state comparison
explanation: Restored Charge requires identity and financial fields, while equals/hashCode compare identity only. Comparing equal entities therefore does not verify that status, amount, timestamps or revision remained unchanged.

Entity identity semantics can support a control but cannot replace full-state observations for rejected operations. No general immutability, concurrency or snapshot guarantee follows from ID-only equality; the restore path does not verify timestamp order/history.
